messages:
rachel: sharing quick bench for tempest-13b (int6 vs int4). small run, want product/ops guidance on routing.
diego: paste the table plz.
rachel: short-run (3k tokens per model) mixed slices: multi-turn summarize, extraction, short QA.

```
model                 | tok/s | p95(ms) | $/1k tok | QA delta vs int6
tempest-13b-int6       | 115   | 220     | $0.84    | baseline
tempest-13b-int4       | 198   | 310     | $0.48    | -2.1% overall; -3.6% long-sum
```

sana: int4 looks attractive cost-wise but p95 jump and long-sum hit are concerning. how stable are these deltas?
rachel: bootstrap 95% CI overall ~0.7%. long-sum slice CI ~1.8%. ran 3 seeds, direction consistent.
diego: product: which customer patterns will feel this?
sana: customers using long-form note-taking & legal summaries will notice drop. short QA customers likely fine.
leo: operational split idea: default = int6 for latency-sensitive flows; economy route -> int4 for batch/backfill. shadow int4 in prod at 5% for non-critical tenants.
rachel: proposal: 
- Default: keep int6 for frontdoor and GTN flows.
- Batch/Econ: route embeddings, backfills, async summarization to int4.
- Canary: shadow int4 at 5% (no summaries) and collect online quality signals for 7 days.
- Eval: run 120k-token synthetic sweep focused on long contexts + rare-entity to tighten CI and test priming variants.
- Criteria to expand: if overall int4 delta <= -0.6% and long-sum slice improves to > -1.5% after priming, consider 25% routing for non-low-latency workloads.

diego: rollback/runbook bullets?
sana: runbook draft:
- metrics: slice_longsum_precision, p95_latency, user_ctr_proxy, decode_error_rate, hallucination_rate.
- hard rollback triggers: slice_longsum_precision drop >2% sustained for 15m OR decode_error_rate >0.75% absolute.
- soft rollback triggers: overall QA drop >1% for 60m with p<0.05 OR user_ctr_proxy down >3% for canary cohort.
- mitigations: throttle int4 traffic, route affected tenants to int6, enable KV warmstart, apply priming patch, increase prefix cache.

leo: infra notes: need per-route feature flag + per-tenant fallback and metrics tagging. ETA 30h to wire dashboards and flag.
infra-bot: feature flag created: feature/eng-ml/tempest-int4-canary (owner: leo).
rachel: action items:
- diego: run 120k synthetic sweep with 4 priming variants + KV warmstart tests (ETA 72h).
- leo: wire feature flag + dashboards (ETA 30h).
- rachel: publish scorecard + TL;DR for GTN & product (ETA 48h).

sana: small optimization note: in previous models a short-system-prompt tweak recovered ~1.0% on long-sum in some cases. include that in sweep.
diego: agreed, will include prompt variants and a token-penalty ablation.
rachel: ETA for preliminary online shadow metrics after flag: 7 days. we'll pause expansion until sweep + online signals match criteria.
leo: will set alerts for rollback triggers and a fallback automation to reroute canary to int6 if decode_error_rate crosses threshold.
sana: product ok with shadow + batch routing if runbook in place.
diego: thanks team. please tag me on the scorecard when ready. :rocket:
thread_text: tempest-13b int6 vs int4 bench; cost-quality routing proposal, canary and runbook
